essence: Mere knowledge alone gives rise to auspicious and inauspicious results.
These dual experiences likewise arise through the same means.
This marks the end of the sixth chapter of the Uḍḍāmareśvara Mahātantra.
By the mere application of this power, deities become subjugated.
She is worshipped by gods and demons and accomplishes all purposes.
